Metadata.title: PlatePilot — Your restaurant, from first order to close
Metadata.description: Ordering, payments, reservations, kitchen service and a live dining-room view in one calm restaurant operating system.

Footer.tagline: Your restaurant, from first order to close.

Home.title: Service has enough moving parts.
Home.description: PlatePilot brings ordering, payments, tables and the kitchen into one clear rhythm—so your team can focus on the people in front of them.
Home.note: Start with your real data. No demo restaurant required.
Home.previewTitle: A room your team can read.
Home.previewDescription: Build the view from your own floor plan. Every table stays connected to service, reservations and the POS.
Home.previewEmptyBody: Add real dimensions, tables and zones. Nothing is pre-filled.
Home.productDescription: Each handoff stays visible, accountable and connected to the same order—without making your team learn a dozen different tools.
Home.orderingBody: Pickup, delivery, dine-in QR and scheduled orders, priced from your published menu and service rules.
Home.paymentsBody: Hosted checkout, authentic webhooks, independent verification and reconciliation that separates payment from fulfillment.
Home.floorTitle: A floor plan that does work
Home.floorBody: Plan in accessible 2D, then opt into 3D. The same table drives reservations, QR sessions and open checks.
Home.kitchenTitle: A kitchen always in the loop
Home.kitchenBody: Route items by station, track preparation and create one ticket—even when a provider sends the same event twice.
Home.floorSectionTitle: See the room. Know the next move.
Home.floorSectionBody: Available, reserved, seated or resetting: table state is clear at a glance and always available as text. The 3D view loads only when asked, and every workflow remains usable in 2D.
Home.floorPointTwo: Real dimensions in metres, not a stock room
Home.floorPointThree: Automatic fallback when WebGL is unavailable
Home.globalBody: Keep country, language, currency and settlement independent. Exact minor-unit money, explicit price books and five launch languages—including right-to-left Arabic—are part of the foundation, not an afterthought.
Home.securityTitle: The quiet checks behind every busy service.
Home.securityBody: Tenant isolation, least-privilege access, immutable payment amounts and durable event processing are built into the workflow. Google discovery never proves ownership, and a browser redirect never marks an order paid.
Home.closingBody: Start with your restaurant, your menu and your floor plan. PlatePilot keeps the system empty until your real data arrives.

Login.title: Welcome back to service.
Login.description: Use your work email to receive a secure sign-in link. Access is limited to your organization and assigned locations.
Login.sentBody: If the account is eligible, a sign-in link has been requested. Open it on this device to continue.
Login.notConfiguredBody: Add the public Supabase project URL and anonymous key to enable secure staff sign-in. No account or session has been created.
Login.linkExpired: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Request a new one, and open it on this device.
Login.rateLimited: Too many sign-in emails have been requested in the last hour. Wait a little and try again.
Login.sendFailed: The sign-in email could not be sent. Check the address and try again.
Login.invalidCredentials: That email and password do not match an account.

Onboarding.title: Start with what’s real.
Onboarding.description: Connect a public listing for identification or enter everything yourself. Your operating details always come from you.
Onboarding.findBody: Search by name and city or address. Selecting a branch links its Place ID; it never grants ownership or access.
Onboarding.googleUnavailable: Google discovery is not configured. Manual setup is fully available.
Onboarding.searchUnavailable: Live search requires authentication, onboarding permission and a configured Google key.
Onboarding.noResults: No listings found. Check the branch address or continue manually.
Onboarding.googleAttribution: Search results provided by Google. Third-party attribution is shown when supplied.
Onboarding.manualBody: These details are merchant-supplied and remain separate from any public listing.
Onboarding.name: Restaurant name
Onboarding.menuBody: Upload a merchant-owned CSV. PlatePilot validates a preview before anything can be published. No prices, allergens, photos or availability are invented.
Onboarding.authRequired: Sign in to create a workspace or publish a menu. Your draft remains on this page.
Onboarding.configRequired: Persistence is not configured yet. You can inspect the setup flow, but no business has been created.
Onboarding.reviewBody: Ordering stays disabled until a real menu, service settings, payment eligibility and merchant review are complete.
Onboarding.error: The request could not be completed. No success was recorded.
Onboarding.signInTitle: Sign in to start setting up.
Onboarding.signInBody: PlatePilot needs to know who owns this restaurant before it can create a workspace. Use the email address your restaurant will use for service.
Onboarding.signInRequired: Sign in with your staff account before creating a workspace. A place listing is not proof of ownership.

Floor.title: Make the room yours.
Floor.description: Build an accessible plan from real measurements. This public planner keeps your draft in this browser; publishing requires an authorized restaurant workspace.
Floor.emptyBody: Enter the room dimensions, then add your first table. No stock layout or fictional tables are provided.
Floor.threeDBody: Optional static rendering. Your 2D controls remain available.
Floor.threeDError: 3D is unavailable on this device. Continue with the fully working 2D plan.
Floor.instructions: Select a table to edit it. Use arrow keys to move a selected table; hold Shift for larger steps.
Floor.summary: {count, plural, =0 {No tables yet} one {# table} other {# tables}}
Floor.publishUnavailable: Sign in and select an authorized location to publish. Your local draft is unchanged.
Floor.serviceEmpty: No live check is connected in this local planner. Publish to an authorized workspace to connect service.

Operations.title: The operating picture, without the noise.
Operations.description: Every module below reads real merchant data. Empty means empty; unavailable integrations say so. No decorative sales charts or fictional activity.
Operations.workspaceBody: Create or join an authorized restaurant workspace to open live orders, shifts, stock and reporting. Until then, this page is a capability guide—not a connected dashboard.
Operations.ordersBody: Server-priced pickup, delivery and dine-in orders with scoped guest tracking.
Operations.posBody: Walk-in checks, split tenders, discrepancies and end-of-day close.
Operations.reservationsBody: Transactional capacity, table assignment, deposits and no-show handling.
Operations.kitchenBody: Station routing, prep states, bump/recall and reconnect fallback.
Operations.inventoryBody: Versioned recipes, suppliers and an append-only stock movement ledger.
Operations.deliveryBody: Zones, scoped driver views, completion evidence and exceptions.
Operations.crmBody: Consent-led preferences, visits and reversible loyalty entries.
Operations.reportsBody: Currency-separated sales, refunds, tax, tips and close-of-day exports.
Operations.integrationsBody: Explicit connection status, safe tests, sync history and honest CSV fallbacks.

Settings.title: How this location trades
Settings.description: Open the storefront, set the hours you serve, what delivery costs and which tables can be booked. Everything here is read by the ordering and reservation functions the moment you save.
Settings.signInRequired: Sign in to change how a location trades.
Settings.noLocation: You do not have a location yet. Finish onboarding first.

service.title: {location} — ordering
service.description: While ordering is on, the published menu on your storefront takes orders at the price you set.
service.closedHint: The storefront is closed: an order placed now is refused with ORDERING_NOT_ENABLED.
service.hoursHint: A day with no window is closed. Times are in the location timezone.
service.deliveryFeeHint: Added to a delivery order, in {currency}.
service.minimumOrderHint: A delivery order below this is refused.
service.taxHint: Applied to the subtotal and shown on the receipt.
service.prepMinutesHint: How long the kitchen needs before pickup.
service.postalCodesHint: Leave empty to deliver to the whole area.
service.smsPhoneHint: Where paid-order SMS alerts go, in international format.

zones.title: Delivery zones
zones.description: Charge different delivery fees by postal area. The longest matching prefix wins, so 8001 can cost less than the wider 80 region.
zones.name: Zone name
zones.prefixesHint: Comma separated. A customer's postal code is matched by prefix.
zones.empty: No zones yet. Without zones the flat delivery fee in service settings applies everywhere.

campaigns.title: Storefront campaigns
campaigns.description: Scheduled popups and banners on your storefront. A discount code shown here is enforced by the promotion's own limits at order time.
campaigns.headline: Headline

domains.title: Your own domain
domains.description: Serve your storefront from your own address. Point a CNAME at {target}, then verify — the check is a real DNS lookup.
domains.claimHint: You own it; we verify it.

google.title: Find your restaurant
google.description: Search Google for your restaurant and link the right branch. The link feeds structured data to search engines; it is not an ownership claim.
google.notConfigured: Google Places search is not configured on this deployment yet — add a Places API key to enable it.

venue.tablesDescription: A reservation is accepted against these. Sync from the floor planner to book what you have drawn.
venue.synced: Tables updated from the floor plan.
venue.name: Table name
venue.noTables: No tables yet. Add one here, or draw the room and sync it.
venue.customersDescription: Read from the orders this location took. Nothing is copied, so the list never disagrees with the till.

errors.INVALID_SETTINGS: One of the values is out of range.
errors.INVALID_SERVICE_AREA: A postal code is empty or too long.

errors.ZONE_INCOMPLETE: Every zone needs a name and at least one postal prefix.
errors.DELIVERY_MIN_ORDER: The order is below this zone's minimum for delivery.
errors.OUTSIDE_SERVICE_AREA: We do not deliver to that postal code.
errors.INVALID_DOMAIN: That does not look like a domain name.
errors.DOMAIN_TAKEN: That domain is already claimed by another organization.
